subject: Literature
title: Mo Yan and Chinese Storytelling
description: A quick win: understand Mo Yan and Chinese Storytelling.

hook.text: Mo Yan won the 2012 Nobel, becoming the first Chinese citizen to receive the literature prize while living in China.

buildup.text: His novels blend folklore, history, and surrealism to depict rural Chinese life across the twentieth century.

discovery.text: His pen name, Mo Yan, means 'don't speak,' chosen because his parents warned him to stay silent to survive.

twist.text: Chinese dissidents criticized the award because Mo Yan avoided confronting the government directly in his public life.

climax.text: His prize reignited debate about whether a writer must be politically courageous to deserve literary recognition.

punchline.text: A man named 'Don't Speak' won the world's literary voice.

quiz.question: What does Mo Yan's pen name mean?
